fact.claim: Cipher Digital (CIFR) shares fell about 58% over the month to November 4, 2026. On November 4 alone the stock was down 18% at $6.64, and in a 24-hour snapshot published on November 5 it was down 16.31%, the steepest drop among five crypto-mining stocks. The 58% is a one-month move, not a drop from the 52-week or all-time high, and these figures are intraday snapshots from news sites, not official closing prices.
